notes.title: Beta branch is live!
notes.content: [h2]🌟 Beta Branch Now Live for [i]Star Rising[/i] — Help Shape the Future![/h2][p]Greetings adventurers,[/p][p]We’re excited to announce the launch of a [b]Beta Branch[/b] for [i]Star Rising[/i], our deckbuilding dungeon crawler! This new branch gives you early access to upcoming features and fixes before they hit the main game — and your feedback will be invaluable in helping us refine them.[/p][h3]🧪 What Is the Beta Branch?[/h3][p]The Beta Branch is a lightly tested version of [i]Star Rising[/i] that includes experimental updates and improvements. It’s designed for players who want to be part of the development journey and don’t mind a few rough edges along the way.[/p][p]By opting in, you’ll:[/p][list][*][p]Get a sneak peek at upcoming changes[/p][/*][*][p]Help us catch bugs and balance issues[/p][/*][*][p]Directly influence the game’s evolution through your feedback[/p][/*][/list][h3]🚀 What’s New in the First Beta Build?[/h3][p]This initial beta update includes:[/p][list][*][p][b]Framerate improvements[/b] across multiple dungeon environments[/p][/*][*][p][b]Audio bug fixes[/b], including missing sound effects and looping issues[/p][/*][/list][p]We’re actively monitoring performance and stability, so your reports will help us fine-tune these changes before they go live for everyone.[/p][h3]🔧 How to Access the Beta Branch[/h3][olist][*][p]Right-click [i]Star Rising[/i] in your Steam Library[/p][/*][*][p]Select [b]Properties[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Go to the [b]Betas[/b] tab[/p][/*][*][p]Choose [b]beta - public test branch[/b] from the dropdown[/p][/*][/olist][p]No password required — just opt in and start exploring![/p][p]Thank you for being part of this journey. Your support and input mean the world to us as we continue building [i]Star Rising[/i] into the best deckbuilding dungeon crawler it can be.[/p][p]See you in the depths, — The [i]Star Rising[/i] Dev Team[/p]
